abi_facts: The sysinfo and flash groups use separate vectors at 8c0000b0 and 8c0000b8.
R7 selects the function. Sysinfo selectors zero and three initialize and return an information pointer; the KOS ID wrapper dereferences that pointer.
Flash selector one takes offset, destination and byte count in R4/R5/R6. The documented result is bytes read, or -1.
The KOS header documents sysinfo initialization preparing data in guest 8c000068..8c00007f.
declared_host_choices: Immutable caller-supplied 24-byte information and independent flash byte spans; no default console identity or flash image.
Information init copies those explicit bytes to guest 8c000068. Pointer query requires successful init. Exact BIOS data extraction and scratch register clobbers are not recovered.
Void initialization preserves R0; all unrelated CPU registers are preserved.
Read-only flash service returns a count or guest -1. Unconfigured/unsupported operations are explicit host stops.
Native callbacks use separate non-game markers 8c00f110/8c00f120, distinct from the existing disc marker.
game_evidence: Original 8c10c044 classifies the returned information byte at offset twelve.

Original 8c603b84 requests two flash bytes at offset 1a05e and checks for a zero result before an optional override/cache path. The count-returning host policy leaves that override path unverified; no successful zero result is invented.
scope: Primary wrapper/header ABI evidence and separately declared host policy; not decompiled BIOS, measured hardware data or a claim that private synthetic inputs are authentic console records.
